links.outcome: LLM accuracy on validated cardiovascular antithrombotic care scenarios
links.effect: Claude 3 Opus answered 85% correctly; GPT-4o 55%, Claude 3.5 Sonnet 44%, GPT-3.5 10%. Some free-tier models gave inappropriate medical advice to clinicians.
links.quote: The performance of LLMs in cardiovascular clinical scenarios varied widely, with some models outperforming clinicians, and some free-tier models providing inappropriate medical advice to clinicians.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance of seven LLMs against clinician performance on validated cardiovascular antithrombotic clinical scenarios, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
